approach: XenonRecomp static recompilation with a Vulkan renderer at the GPU command-processor level (EDRAM tile model, Xenos shaders to SPIR-V); MoltenVK on iPad, native Vulkan on Android
notes: Playable on Windows at 60 fps (menus, training, exhibition matches, sound, saves). Playable on an M2 iPad (iPadOS, sideloaded) with touch controls or a Bluetooth controller: matches at 40-45 fps, set pieces and cutscenes slower for now. Android support is early (branch android-early): one arm64 APK for every GPU (Vulkan 1.1), tested on a Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 tablet with touch or a controller, menus at 60 fps and matches around 27 fps. No game files are included; build it from your own disc.
